example_patches.question: Yelp宠物类商家占所有商家的百分比是多少？

replacement.query: SELECT 100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT bc.business_id)/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public_review_platform.Business),0) AS percentage FROM public_review_platform.Business_Categories bc JOIN public_review_platform.Categories c ON c.category_id=bc.category_id WHERE c.category_name='Pets'

example_patches.reason: 所有商家是Business实体；类别关系不是分母。

example_patches.question: Yelp上Phoenix市有多少商家？Phoenix市商家占所有城市的百分比是多少？

replacement.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN city='Phoenix' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN city='Phoenix' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS percentage FROM public_review_platform.Business

example_patches.reason: 城市商家计数与占比不需要关联类别表，避免重复及遗漏无类别商家。

example_patches.question: Yelp上Chandler市房地产行业且评分为5星的商家占Chandler市所有商家的百分比是多少？

replacement.query: SELECT 100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT b.business_id)/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public_review_platform.Business WHERE city='Chandler'),0) AS percentage FROM public_review_platform.Business b WHERE b.city='Chandler' AND b.stars=5 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public_review_platform.Business_Categories bc JOIN public_review_platform.Categories c ON c.category_id=bc.category_id WHERE bc.business_id=b.business_id AND c.category_name='Real Estate')

example_patches.reason: 题目分母是Chandler所有商家，而非房地产商家。仅用于训练示例覆盖；不改验证金标。

example_patches.question: 计算Yelp上具备接受信用卡属性的商家占所有商家的百分比。

replacement.query: SELECT 100.0*COUNT(*)/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public_review_platform.Business),0) AS percentage FROM public_review_platform.Business b WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public_review_platform.Business_Attributes ba JOIN public_review_platform.Attributes a ON a.attribute_id=ba.attribute_id WHERE ba.business_id=b.business_id AND a.attribute_name='Accepts Credit Cards' AND LOWER(ba.attribute_value)='true')

example_patches.reason: 接受信用卡需属性值为true；分母含全部商家，避免按属性行计数。

example_patches.question: 基于凤凰城的Yelp商家，计算有趣投票数低的商家百分比。

replacement.query: SELECT 100.0*COUNT(*)/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public_review_platform.Business WHERE city='Phoenix'),0) AS percentage FROM public_review_platform.Business b WHERE b.city='Phoenix' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public_review_platform.Reviews r WHERE r.business_id=b.business_id AND r.review_votes_funny='Low')

example_patches.reason: 具有低有趣投票评论的商家按存在性去重；每商家可有多评论。

example_patches.question: 东部联盟全明星球员的平均身高是多少？

replacement.query: SELECT AVG(p.height) FROM professional_basketball.players p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM professional_basketball.player_allstar a WHERE a.playerID=p.playerID AND a.conference='East')

example_patches.reason: 去重球员而非AVG(DISTINCT height)；同身高不同球员均应计入。

example_patches.question: 2010年获得NBA年度最佳教练奖的教练执教的是哪支球队？

replacement.query: SELECT DISTINCT c.tmID FROM professional_basketball.coaches c JOIN professional_basketball.awards_coaches a ON a.coachID=c.coachID AND a.year=c.year WHERE a.year=2010 AND a.award='NBA Coach of the Year'

example_patches.reason: 获奖当年球队，补上年份关联，不包含职业生涯其他年份球队。

example_patches.question: 1977年NBA年度最佳教练奖得主在1976年执教的球队属于哪个赛区？

replacement.query: SELECT DISTINCT t.divID FROM professional_basketball.awards_coaches a JOIN professional_basketball.coaches c ON a.coachID=c.coachID JOIN professional_basketball.teams t ON c.tmID=t.tmID AND c.year=t.year WHERE a.year=1977 AND a.award='NBA Coach of the Year' AND c.year=1976

example_patches.reason: 题目明确获奖年1977与执教年1976不同，球队表须与实际执教年份匹配。

example_patches.question: 哪个发行商发行的游戏数量最多？

replacement.query: SELECT p.publisher_name FROM video_games.publisher p JOIN video_games.game_publisher gp ON gp.publisher_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id,p.publisher_name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT gp.game_id) DESC,p.id ASC LIMIT 1

example_patches.reason: 按发行商主键统计不同游戏，不统计发行商ID或发行关系条数；并列按ID稳定取一。

example_patches.question: 哪个发行商发行的动作类游戏最多？

replacement.query: SELECT p.publisher_name FROM video_games.publisher p JOIN video_games.game_publisher gp ON gp.publisher_id=p.id JOIN video_games.game g ON g.id=gp.game_id JOIN video_games.genre ge ON ge.id=g.genre_id WHERE ge.genre_name='Action' GROUP BY p.id,p.publisher_name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT g.id) DESC,p.id ASC LIMIT 1

example_patches.reason: 按发行商主键区分同名主体，并按不同游戏数排名。

example_patches.question: 哪个发行商发行的益智类游戏最多？

replacement.query: SELECT p.publisher_name FROM video_games.publisher p JOIN video_games.game_publisher gp ON gp.publisher_id=p.id JOIN video_games.game g ON g.id=gp.game_id JOIN video_games.genre ge ON ge.id=g.genre_id WHERE ge.genre_name='Puzzle' GROUP BY p.id,p.publisher_name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT g.id) DESC,p.id ASC LIMIT 1

example_patches.reason: 按发行商主键区分同名主体，并按不同游戏数排名。

example_patches.question: 购书客户中，位于美国的客户所在的城市有哪些？

replacement.query: SELECT DISTINCT a.city FROM books.customer c JOIN books.customer_address ca ON ca.customer_id=c.customer_id JOIN books.address a ON a.address_id=ca.address_id JOIN books.country co ON co.country_id=a.country_id WHERE co.country_name='United States of America'

example_patches.reason: 限定客户实际关联地址；不把地址维表全部城市当成客户城市，不额外推断当前地址或已下单。

example_patches.question: 列出任意5个2006年成为Yelp精英用户的用户ID。

replacement.query: SELECT e.user_id FROM public_review_platform.Elite e JOIN public_review_platform.Years y ON y.year_id=e.year_id WHERE y.actual_year=2006 ORDER BY e.user_id LIMIT 5

example_patches.reason: year_id是Years外键；按actual_year筛选，即使代理键恰等于年份也保持兼容。

example_patches.question: 有多少用户在加入Yelp的同一年就成为精英用户？

replacement.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) FROM public_review_platform.Users u JOIN public_review_platform.Elite e ON e.user_id=u.user_id JOIN public_review_platform.Years y ON y.year_id=e.year_id WHERE u.user_yelping_since_year=y.actual_year

example_patches.reason: 比较加入实际年份与精英实际年份，按用户去重。

example_patches.question: 拥有极多粉丝的Yelp用户平均需要多少年才能成为精英用户？

replacement.query: WITH first_elite AS (SELECT e.user_id,MIN(y.actual_year) AS first_year FROM public_review_platform.Elite e JOIN public_review_platform.Years y ON y.year_id=e.year_id GROUP BY e.user_id) SELECT AVG(f.first_year-u.user_yelping_since_year) FROM public_review_platform.Users u JOIN first_elite f ON f.user_id=u.user_id WHERE u.user_fans='Uber'

example_patches.reason: 首次成为精英的实际年份减加入年份，再按用户平均，不按每次精英记录重复加权。

example_patches.question: Yelp商家编号5734周六营业多少小时？

replacement.query:
WITH parsed_hours AS (SELECT business_id,day_id,CASE WHEN opening_time IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(opening_time)) IN ('','none','null') THEN NULL ELSE (CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(opening_time)) LIKE '%am' OR LOWER(TRIM(opening_time)) LIKE '%pm' THEN CAST(opening_time AS INTEGER)%12 + CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(opening_time)) LIKE '%pm' THEN 12 ELSE 0 END ELSE CAST(opening_time AS INTEGER) END)*60 + CASE WHEN INSTR(opening_time,':')>0 THEN CAST(SUBSTR(opening_time,INSTR(opening_time,':')+1,2) AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END END AS opening_minutes,CASE WHEN closing_time IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(closing_time)) IN ('','none','null') THEN NULL ELSE (CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(closing_time)) LIKE '%am' OR LOWER(TRIM(closing_time)) LIKE '%pm' THEN CAST(closing_time AS INTEGER)%12 + CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(closing_time)) LIKE '%pm' THEN 12 ELSE 0 END ELSE CAST(closing_time AS INTEGER) END)*60 + CASE WHEN INSTR(closing_time,':')>0 THEN CAST(SUBSTR(closing_time,INSTR(closing_time,':')+1,2) AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END END AS closing_minutes FROM public_review_platform.Business_Hours),
normalized_hours AS (SELECT business_id,day_id,CASE WHEN opening_minutes IS NULL OR closing_minutes IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN opening_minutes=closing_minutes THEN 24.0 WHEN closing_minutes>opening_minutes THEN (closing_minutes-opening_minutes)/60.0 ELSE (closing_minutes-opening_minutes+1440)/60.0 END AS hours FROM parsed_hours)
SELECT h.hours AS hour FROM normalized_hours h JOIN public_review_platform.Days d ON d.day_id=h.day_id WHERE d.day_of_week='Saturday' AND h.business_id=5734

example_patches.reason: 按知识159解析12小时制文本，支持分钟及跨午夜，同值按知识163视为24小时；平均仅对已提供的有效营业日记录。

example_patches.question: 查询最新位置与MMSI为414000001的船舶最新位置距离10公里以内，且船舶类型为货船的其他船舶。

replacement.query: WITH target AS (SELECT geom FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE mmsi=414000001 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1), latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (mmsi) * FROM vessel_ais_data ORDER BY mmsi,timestamp DESC) SELECT v.* FROM latest v CROSS JOIN target t WHERE v.mmsi!=414000001 AND v.vessel_type=70 AND ST_DWithin(v.geom::geography,t.geom::geography,10000)

example_patches.reason: 先按每船取真正最新记录，再判断距离；不得用范围内旧位置代替最新位置。
